positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborate cross-functionally to plan, build, and ship features and improvements for a rapidly growing site
- Act as technical lead to integrate Wirecutter content with The New York Times’ publishing pipeline, contributing to a significant increase in organic traffic
- Serve as a member of Wirecutter’s Engineering Advisory Board, helping to provide guidance and ensure we maintain a high level of quality as our codebase, teams, and infrastructure grow
- Mentor fellow engineers through pair programming, code review, and onboarding support
- Participate in interview panels and debriefs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built responsive React components to enable the launch of a new content type
- Contributed to the implementation of a new tool to allow CMS users to manage redirects
- Worked on mission-critical domain migration project, writing scope documents and QA plans
- Helped establish an improved release workflow, making the deployment process simpler and smoother for engineers across several teams

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for all front-end engineering for the prototype of a set of tools designed to enable home builders to better communicate with their customers, including a Vue.js admin dashboard and a React Native iOS/Android app
- Developed responsive websites from start to finish, working from mock-ups to craft systems of reusable components based on atomic design principles
- Contributed to the planning and development of internal tools to make processes more efficient
- Collaborated with UI/UX designers, project managers, strategists, and fellow developers to build new features, fix bugs, and implement UX improvements for client websites
- Roadmapped, estimated, and wrote use cases for new projects and features
- Participated in code reviews, manual testing, end-of-sprint retrospectives, documentation writing, and creation/improvement of coding standards

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed front-end code for complex sites and web-based applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript while being mindful of maintainability, loading times, SEO best practices, and scalability
- Worked with designers and back-end developers to solve problems in a fast-paced environment

positions.title: Web Designer & Front-End Developer
positions.description:
- Worked directly with clients to design and build custom websites from the ground up for a variety of small businesses and local organizations
- Managed project schedules, deadlines, and budgets
- Developed and coded HTML email templates
- Designed flyers, posters, ads, and postcards for print
